subject: Shiny web performance and load - data journalism problem

messages.subject: Shiny web performance and load - data journalism problem
parts:
Hi,

in start I need apologize for my bad English (I am from Czech republic). 

I have two questions. I prepare small application on free Shiny hosting. Basically its small corpus viewer in Shiny-R and with ElasticSearch in backend (ES has own server). Application shows time changes in vocabulary of our current president and you can see it here http://glimmer.rstudio.com/josefslerka/klausslovnik

Histogram counting is done by ES. Shiny and R is there only for graph plot and trend counting on small dataset.  

I received email from one of Czech newspaper and guys from their data-department ask me abou possibilities to embed this page to their webpage for few days (we have new president in our country). Problem is that their expect probably more then 10.000 req/per day and I have no idea about load and performance of Shiny web server.  Siege detected that 15 paralel request is ok for render page, but no info about R performance.

In fact in will be one-day-shot but what is best solution for me? It will be one day load, but ...?

Any suggest or experience?

Josef Slerka
